description: Source code implementing a trust store that loads certificates from memory and disk, specifically for the Raspberry Pi 4 platform, using BoringSSL and Starboard APIs.

classes.name: TrustStoreInMemoryStarboard
classes.description: A trust store that loads and manages certificates from memory and disk for the Raspberry Pi platform.

methods.name: TrustStoreInMemoryStarboard::TryLoadCert
methods.description: Attempts to load a certificate by name from disk, returning a parsed certificate if successful.

methods.name: TrustStoreInMemoryStarboard::SyncGetIssuersOf
methods.description: Retrieves issuer certificates for a given certificate, loading from disk if not found in memory.

methods.name: TrustStoreInMemoryStarboard::GetTrust
methods.description: Determines the trust level of a given certificate, loading from disk if trust is unspecified.
